input.name: arm-delegates-to-the-annotation-plugin
input.covers: Current armAsset forwards bytes, intrinsic aspect, target width and identifier; disarm drops both public reads and the interaction tool arm.

input.name: the-target-width-sizes-the-ghost-and-a-template-ghost-is-cached
input.covers: Current hover image ghost follows page-space point and intrinsic aspect; two arms share one source-byte render in a width bucket.

input.name: a-raster-asset-arms-with-its-own-preview
input.covers: A raster asset becomes a canonical PDF page with a rendered thumbnail; its placement aspect and rendered ghost survive. A PDF import whose preview render refuses leaves the raster arm and existing resources intact.

input.name: arming-what-is-not-there
input.covers: Unknown assets reject not-found; missing annotation capability and closed document reject permission-denied. Disarm is safely inert.

input.name: scripting-off-arms-the-template
input.covers: The dynamic setting false prevents detached copies even under an enabled actions scripting host.

input.name: no-sandbox-host
input.covers: Without an actions host the template arms unchanged. Enabled actions with no injected sandbox uses current default QuickJS and is separately deferred to D.

input.name: a-raster-asset-is-never-evaluated
input.covers: Canonical raster assets can carry forms now; a raster-authored page with no selected-page field opens/closes a copy and arms without creating a script realm.

input.name: a-stamp-without-fields-on-its-page-arms-the-template
input.covers: A field on another page does not count: close the copy and arm unchanged reusable bytes.

input.name: materializes-a-dynamic-stamp
input.covers: The detached copy uses target identity/time/seed, current native form ops, flatten and extraction; the canonical library and page cache remain unchanged.

input.name: a-loose-dynamic-stamp
input.covers: A PDF createAsset produces a canonical single-asset library, then evaluates the selected appended page; identityless target uses default identity.

input.name: dynamic-stamp-refusals
input.covers: Closed target permission, absent canonical page, required flatten Unsupported and extract Io each refuse precisely, close the detached copy and leave no arm.

input.name: a-failed-boot-script-is-a-diagnostic
input.covers: A boot exception is surfaced as a continuing diagnostic without a script-failed event, while accepted recalculate still arms.

input.name: a-failed-recalculation-fails-the-arm
input.covers: Aggregate effect budget failure surfaces exact diagnostics/UI/error, rejects operation-failed, disposes realm and closes copy without arming.

input.name: an-error-observer-that-throws
input.covers: A throwing script-failed listener is isolated by the kernel report channel; the current arm still rejects its own budget failure.

input.name: observers-see-a-successful-run
input.covers: Current actions UI adapter and event hooks surface accepted script outputs. A throwing UI adapter rejects the arm and finally closes the copy.

input.name: a-flatten-that-fails-or-skips
input.covers: Current flatten is all-or-nothing: engine refusal rejects the arm; typed unchanged is a successful no-op and still materializes.

input.name: a-failed-copy-close-fails-the-arm
input.covers: Copy close Io overrides a successful materialization. A well-typed URL-only image has no source bytes and rejects unsupported after close.

input.name: a-library-without-canonical-bytes
input.covers: Explicit malformed download/extract replies exercise current fallback: evaluate extracted page when canonical bytes absent; invalid missing placement bytes reject by the current binary resolver.

input.name: teardown-destroys-a-factory-engine-once
input.covers: The lazily-created local engine is memoized across library and detached-copy opens and destroyed exactly once.

input.name: dynamic-placement-writes-materialized-bytes-and-batch-facts
input.covers: Direct and batch placement use each fresh detached materialization as annotation appearance resources; one refused page does not suppress the later successful page or its fact and public readback.

input.name: file-picker-places-cancels-and-expires-the-click
input.covers: The current prompt provider receives the typed page-space request; picked PNG bytes create one stamp, cancel creates none, and a delayed result after a tool change expires without a write.

input.name: permission-refusal-recovers-on-an-authorized-document
input.covers: An open read-only document refuses arm/place before asset copies; an independently authorized document can subsequently arm and disarm the same asset.
